item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must treat that danger as urgent—and act before it’s too late.

2. We believe this plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. The stakes demand serious action now, not after the damage is done.

3. Superintelligent AI is not a risk we can afford to wave away. If it’s built in the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must prevent that future.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We face a clear and urgent danger: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. This is not a distant possibility we can safely set aside. It is the future we must work to prevent. We cannot wait for a catastrophe to prove what is at stake, or assume that good intentions will make powerful systems safe. We need to confront the consequences of building superintelligent AI and demand action before it exists. The choices made now will shape whether we avert this disaster—or allow it to happen.
